description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. Approved wheeled all-terrain vehicle roadways are defined by county ordinances with amendments effective in 2019, 2021 and 2023. Attributes include road number, name, begin/end measures, length and speed limit. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for network flow studies. This is a legal-access restriction layer, not observed vehicle traffic or proof that every listed road remains open. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
